dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast light-toned perimeters forming interconnected closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shapes. The edges exhibit sharp gradient transitions from the dark exterior pixel base to thin, high-intensity interior lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized dark, asymmetrical pixel clusters contained within the centers of the light-toned annular structures, primarily concentrated in the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent annular structures in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship. An additional series of centroids form a staggered, roughly linear chain along the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated network pattern consisting of interlocking polygonal and circular high-contrast motifs covering the majority of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
